author: Praxis I
title: Dual-BRBG-Whitened: Rank-Weighted Balanced kNN (k=45)
abstract: Single-change variant of the 0.7296 SOTA: keep equal per-batch quotas and union edges, but set connectivities via mutual-rank weights w_ij = 1/(1 + rank_i(j) + rank_j(i)) (magnitude-free), with floor to preserve mixing. Hypothesis: improves ARI/NMI/ASW_label without harming mixing.
